meanings: to keep a firm grip on, to pay close attention to, to lose no time in (doing sth)
to focus one's attention; to concentrate on (doing sth)
to turn sth around, to swivel, to rotate (about an axis), to revolve, to turn, to move in a circle, to gyrate
to pass on, to communicate, to transmit
(of a person) to turn round, to face about, (of a widow) to remarry (archaic)
